runners.name: Magic Mini
runners.comment: MAGIC MINI was void of early speed then altered five wide for the run down the backstretch before taking over the lead on the second turn but raced erratic in the stretch run before drawing clear late.

runners.name: Dorothy
runners.comment: DOROTHY rated in the middle of the pack early then made a steady advance while five wide on the second turn and sustained the bid through the stretch, gaining late to get up for place.

runners.name: Esther's Favor
runners.comment: ESTHER'S FAVOR stalked the early pace then moved up and contested the lead into the second turn and battled through the stretch run before being caught late for place.

runners.name: Cathedral Sun
runners.comment: CATHEDRAL SUN rated in the second flight early while racing four wide under a tight hold then loomed to challenge at the 1/4 pole and made a bid into the stretch but faltered late.

runners.name: Gold Glitters
runners.comment: GOLD GLITTERS exchanged bumps at the start with RECONQUISTA then rated in the second flight early before being steadied nearing the 7/8 pole then was in tight while racing along the rail on the backstretch run before being asked into the stretch and made a mild rally late.

runners.name: Positano Princess
runners.comment: POSITANO PRINCESS raced close up early then was steadied and shuffled nearing the 3/4 pole before being urged at the 3/8 pole but flattened out in the stretch.

runners.name: Bustin Border
runners.comment: BUSTIN BORDER was hustled up and crossed over while setting the early pace then was pressed on the backstretch run and faded in the second turn.

runners.name: Reconquista
runners.comment: RECONQUISTA exchanged bumps at the start with GOLD GLITTERS then settled mid-pack before being steadied while in tight nearing the 7/8 pole then dropped back and never factored.

runners.name: Beautiful Tapdance
runners.comment: BEAUTIFUL TAPDANCE chased the pace while saving ground then battled for a half mile before fading in the stretch.

runners.name: R Delray
runners.comment: R DELRAY got away alertly and pressed the early pace then took over the lead into the stretch and raced all out, holding sway on the wire.

runners.name: Noble Prince
runners.comment: NOBLE PRINCE was void of early speed and saved ground then split horses into the stretch and rallied late for place.

runners.name: Adios Mate
runners.comment: ADIOS MATE settled early and saved ground then angled five wide into the stretch and closed willingly.

runners.name: Hendrickson
runners.comment: HENDRICKSON wouldn't load into the gate then moved up and pressed the early pace, chasing for a half mile before fading in the stretch.

runners.name: Valdero
runners.comment: VALDERO was hustled up and set the early pace while pressed on the lead before being headed in the middle of the turn and gave way in the stretch.

runners.name: Rodhan
runners.comment: RODHAN got brushed at the start by WESTERN SHAFT then rated in the second flight before being carried six wide into the stretch then made no rally.

runners.name: Western Shaft
runners.comment: WESTERN SHAFT got squeezed at the start then rated in the middle of the pack before drifting seven wide nearing the 1/4 pole then faded in the stretch.

runners.name: Lobo Go
runners.comment: LOBO GO got squeezed at the start then showed no speed while racing off the rail before coming up empty in the stretch.

runners.name: R Kan't Miss
runners.comment: R KAN'T MISS broke outward then moved up and stalked the early pace then loomed to challenge at the 1/4 pole and was roused into the stretch, drawing off to win in hand.

runners.name: Guerrera
runners.comment: GUERRERA exchanged bumps at the start with PENNY CHEAPER then moved up along the rail before racing all out into the stretch, getting up late for place.

runners.name: R Nashvegas
runners.comment: R NASHVEGAS got away alertly and set the pace then battled through the turn before being headed nearing the 1/4 pole then was caught late for place.

runners.name: Daughter's Legacy
runners.comment: DAUGHTER'S LEGACY showed no speed early while racing with a rail trip then was asked into the stretch and made a belated bid late.

runners.name: Jukebox Jenny
runners.comment: JUKEBOX JENNY altered to race five wide early and moved up to chase the early pace then was urged nearing the 3/8 pole but just raced evenly in the stretch.

runners.name: Penny Cheaper
runners.comment: PENNY CHEAPER exchanged bumps at the start with GUERRERA then settled along the rail before being asked on the turn but made no rally.

runners.name: Delta Queen
runners.comment: DELTA QUEEN rated in the second flight early and chased between horses then was getting out on the turn but faded in the stretch.

runners.name: Miss Magical
runners.comment: MISS MAGICAL rated in the second flight early then loomed to challenge at the 1/4 pole and sustained the bid while four wide into the stretch, drawing clear late.

runners.name: Miss Valentina
runners.comment: MISS VALENTINA settled early then moved to closer contention nearing the 1/2 pole before waiting behind the leaders through the turn then angled six wide into the stretch and made a late gain for place.

runners.name: Cousin Pammie
runners.comment: COUSIN PAMMIE broke outward then moved up and stalked the early pace before racing under strong urging between horses on the turn and ran on late to hold on for show.

runners.name: Just Majestic
runners.comment: JUST MAJESTIC got away alertly and crossed over in the opening furlong while setting a slow pace then was headed on the turn and gave way in the stretch.

runners.name: Nipsey
runners.comment: NIPSEY was allowed to settle early then dropped back into the turn and never factored.

runners.name: Mindful Grace
runners.comment: MINDFUL GRACE rated in the middle of the pack early then circled horses while six wide on the turn and sustained the bid into the stretch, drawing clear late.

runners.name: Come On Poppi
runners.comment: COME ON POPPI rated in the second flight early with a four wide trip then was urged nearing the 3/8 pole and closed willingly.

runners.name: Spirit of Jamaica
runners.comment: SPIRIT OF JAMAICA rated in the second flight early and tucked in then angled six wide into the stretch and was gaining late.

runners.name: Precious Sight
runners.comment: PRECIOUS SIGHT broke outward then settled and saved ground before making a bid along the rail and a mild rally in the stretch.

runners.name: Tinkatwo
runners.comment: TINKATWO rated in the second flight with a rail trip then angled five wide into the stretch and was asked, gaining belatedly.

runners.name: Smart Lisa
runners.comment: SMART LISA settled early and saved ground for the backstretch run and into the second turn then made a bid between horses in the stretch but just raced evenly late.

runners.name: List
runners.comment: LIST got squeezed at the start then showed no speed early while tucking in to save ground then passed tiring rivals in the stretch.

runners.name: Hippy Hippy Shake
runners.comment: HIPPY HIPPY SHAKE got squeezed at the start and settled early then dropped back before making a bid in the second turn but faltered in the stretch.

runners.name: Dream Diamond
runners.comment: DREAM DIAMOND was hustled away and set the early pace, leading through the turn before being headed nearing the 1/4 pole and faded in the stretch.

runners.name: Boombox Betty
runners.comment: BOOMBOX BETTY raced closed up early and crossed over then chased the early pace before dropping back on the second turn and made no rally late.

runners.name: Role Play
runners.comment: ROLE PLAY stumbled at the start then moved up and stalked the early pace while keen to challenge but dropped back on the second turn and was empty in the stretch.

runners.name: Khozan Ostra
runners.comment: KHOZAN OSTRA was reluctant to load into the gate then moved up and pressed the early pace before taking a lead into the stretch but was headed mid-stretch before fighting back to get up in time.

runners.name: Velocista
runners.comment: VELOCISTA raced closed up early while under a tight hold then waited through the turn before altering four wide into the stretch and rallied to take the lead but was caught late.

runners.name: American Reign
runners.comment: AMERICAN REIGN was hustled up and crossed over early while setting the pace then was headed in the stretch and held show while no match for the top two finishers.

runners.name: Anushka
runners.comment: ANUSHKA was void of early speed and saved ground through the turn before angling five wide in the stretch and made a mild rally late.

runners.name: Playful Tease
runners.comment: PLAYFUL TEASE chased the pace while three wide before dropping back into the turn then drifted seven wide into the stretch but raced evenly late.

runners.name: Mabie's Tavern
runners.comment: MABIE'S TAVERN got off slowly and saved ground then made a bid along the rail but showed no response.

runners.name: Howard Creek
runners.comment: HOWARD CREEK rated in the middle of the pack then dropped back early before drifting out at the 1/4 pole but made no rally.

runners.name: St Margaret's Bay
runners.comment: ST MARGARET'S BAY was void of early speed with a five wide trip but was no threat.

runners.name: Travel Happy
runners.comment: TRAVEL HAPPY chased the pace while three wide then ranged up and loomed nearing the 1/4 pole before taking the lead then raced all out, holding sway on the wire.

runners.name: My Perfect Lady
runners.comment: MY PERFECT LADY was hustled up and pressed the early pace then battled along the rail and ran on to be second best.

runners.name: Happy Ride
runners.comment: HAPPY RIDE exchanged bumps at the start with CHLOE'S TOY then rated in the second flight while saving ground then angled four wide into the stretch and rallied late.

runners.name: Roxy
runners.comment: ROXY was allowed to settle early and saved ground then made a bid along the rail and a mild rally late.

runners.name: Chloe's Toy
runners.comment: CHLOE'S TOY exchanged bumps at the start with HAPPY RIDE then rated in the second flight early before angling five wide into the stretch and raced evenly late.

runners.name: Logistics
runners.comment: LOGISTICS got off slowly and was void of early speed then dropped back on the turn and never threatened.

runners.name: Valiant Victoria
runners.comment: VALIANT VICTORIA got away alertly and set the pace then was headed nearing the 3/8 pole and came up empty in the stretch.

runners.name: Braveness
runners.comment: BRAVENESS was hustled up and pressed the early pace then made a bid between horses in the stretch and was bumped by SHINYHAPPYGROOVY nearing the 1/16 pole then lugged in while rallying to get up in time.

runners.name: Redhotnotbothered
runners.comment: REDHOTNOTBOTHERED broke sharply and set the early pace then raced all out into the stretch before drifting out nearing the 1/16 pole then was caught late.

runners.name: Inhonorofsonny
runners.comment: INHONOROFSONNY rated in the middle of the pack early then angled six wide into the stretch and was asked, rallying late.

runners.name: Shinyhappygroovy
runners.comment: SHINYHAPPYGROOVY rated in the second flight early while racing along the rail then angled out into the stretch and split horses then lacked room and bumped BRAVENESS nearing the 1/16 pole while looking to force through a tight spot then gained late.

runners.name: Titans Edge
runners.comment: TITANS EDGE was void of early speed then waited through the turn before ducking in at the 1/8 pole and rallied late along the rail.

runners.name: Skipping Stars
runners.comment: SKIPPING STARS raced close up early then made a bid between horses into the stretch and battled late before being outfinished.

runners.name: Governor Dutton
runners.comment: GOVERNOR DUTTON rated in the middle of the pack early before angling seven wide nearing the 1/4 pole and was asked into the stretch, racing evenly late.

runners.name: Zevi's Zone
runners.comment: ZEVI'S ZONE rated in the middle of the pack early then was urged between horses nearing the 3/8 pole before angling five wide into the stretch but made no rally.

runners.name: Sharpazano
runners.comment: SHARPAZANO rated in the second flight early and flashed brief foot before dropping back on the turn and came up empty in the stretch. THE STEWARDS CONDUCTED AN INQUIRY INTO THE STRETCH RUN AND THE RIDER OF SHINYHAPPYGROOVY CLAIMED FOUL AGAINST THE RIDER OF BRAVENESS ALLEGING INTERFERENCE IN THE STRETCH. NO CHANGE WAS MADE.

runners.name: Geaux Amy
runners.comment: GEAUX AMY tucked in early and stalked the pace then was urged nearing the 3/8 pole and made a rail rally in the stretch, getting up in time.

runners.name: Das Ist Alles Ally
runners.comment: DAS IST ALLES ALLY rated in the second flight early then made a steady advance while four wide and raced all out in the stretch, running on to be second best.

runners.name: Atmidnight
runners.comment: ATMIDNIGHT got squeezed at the start and was void of early speed then angled five wide into the stretch and rallied late.

runners.name: Pocket Pair
runners.comment: POCKET PAIR raced close up with a rail trip then was asked into the stretch and closed willingly.

runners.name: Birdie Rose
runners.comment: BIRDIE ROSE broke sharply and crossed over early then raced close up while under a tight hold before making a bid between horses into the stretch but was outfinished.

runners.name: Judge Judith
runners.comment: JUDGE JUDITH was fractious in the gate then got away alertly and set a slow pace, leading the field through the second turn before fading in the stretch.

runners.name: Ton a Laughs
runners.comment: TON A LAUGHS was allowed to settle early while racing off the rail then was asked while six wide nearing the 1/4 pole but made no rally.

runners.name: Sunroof
runners.comment: SUNROOF rated in the middle of the pack early while racing under a tight hold then was urged between horses nearing the 1/2 pole and made a bid but faltered into the stretch.
